title: viola heterophylla subsp. ovatifolia
intro: Viola heterophylla subsp. ovatifolia, commonly known as Wild Pansy, is a perennial plant species in the violet family (Violaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to address various health issues, offering benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress levels. The therapeutic actions of Wild Pansy include acting as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties to combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Wild Pansy include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
